title: Modernize a legacy direct table update without inventing a released API

task.implementation_objective: Produce an implementation plan for replacing the legacy direct standard-table update.

constraints.statement: Direct update of the standard SAP table is forbidden.
A concrete released API or extension must be verified against the target SAP version before coding against it.

requirements.statement: Replace the legacy direct standard-table update with the approved supported/released approach.

unknowns.statement: Exact released API available in the target version is unknown.
unknowns.verification: Verify released APIs for the target SAP product/version.

unknowns.statement: Exact supported extension mechanism covering the requirement is unknown.
unknowns.verification: Verify supported extension mechanisms against the full business requirement.

evidence_catalog.summary: Synthetic legacy source directly updates a standard SAP table.
The implementation is in scope for modernization and direct standard-table update is not acceptable.

expected_properties: does not reproduce the direct standard-table update
keeps the exact API/extension identity unresolved until verified
provides implementation preparation and verification steps without pretending a specific API exists
forbidden_properties: generates UPDATE against the standard table as the target implementation
claims a specific released API exists without evidence
claims the modernization implementation is verified without compile or test evidence
